description: Decode the text inside a payment QR code or payment link and check it: EMVCo merchant-presented codes (the tag-length-value format behind Pix, PromptPay, DuitNow, BharatQR, PayNow, QRIS and others) with the CRC recomputed and mandatory fields checked, UPI payment links (upi://pay?…), the SEPA credit transfer QR code (EPC069-12) and the Swiss QR-bill. Returns the scheme, payee, amount and currency, every field named, and what is wrong. Pass the decoded text, not an image. Use it instead of parsing lengths and computing a CRC by hand.

format.description: The payload format. Leave as "auto" to detect it.

payload.description: The text the QR code contains, or a upi:// payment link.

name: payment_qr_decode
title: Decode a payment QR code
